    Positive ordinary paths as string words #

    The positive embedding of the displayed quiver into its symmetrification is injective on paths. Moreover, an ordinary path which survives the relation quotient is a string when every arrow is read positively. The latter fact uses ordinary path factorization: a positive signed subpath of a positive path is an ordinary subpath, so a killed subpath would kill the whole path.
